name: arc-infra-manager
description: Copilot CLI plugin for Azure Arc infrastructure operators covering fleet inventory, health monitoring, remote operations, patch management, compliance auditing, and reporting for hybrid Windows and Linux servers.

prerequisites.description: This plugin is enhanced by the azure-skills plugin from the Microsoft skills marketplace. Install it for compliance scanning (azqr), cross-subscription resource discovery, Azure Monitor observability, cost optimization, RBAC auditing, and architecture visualization. Without azure-skills, core Arc operations (inventory, health, extensions, patching, compliance) still work.
